listing.name: Forza Horizon 2 (Xbox 360) — FH2 Recompiled (Gabrick75)
listing.summary: Upstream reports menus and races running below console performance, with image defects in the native renderer. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Forza Horizon 2 Xbox 360 ISO or complete extracted disc files, title ID 4D530AA4. Supply your own shader library if the selected renderer requires it.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: An Android APK is offered in Releases. Native-renderer shaders and source builds may need local generation from your own USA game files; follow the instructions for your chosen build.

warnings: Upstream reports menus and races running below console performance, with image defects in the native renderer.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
